steps: Certify regularity and positive Jacobian on the closed parameter rectangle.
Certify F(boundary) is an oriented simple Jordan curve: outer, true-normal inner, and both endpoint connectors.
Include actual base/lip closure patches when they differ from normal endpoint fibres; certify exact seams and nonintersection.
Apply planar degree: winding is 1 inside and 0 outside; all interior preimages have positive index, so each interior point has exactly one preimage.
Exclude interior-to-boundary collisions by local openness and exterior degree zero; boundary injectivity handles boundary pairs.
proof_routes.result: global one-to-one normal strip, conditional on all boundary and regularity premises
proof_routes.boundary_proof: exact rational Bezier data plus outward rational enclosures for sqrt-based inner/endpoint curves; shared endpoints require exact equality and a local chart
proof_routes.orientation_check: positive induced orientation or exact winding witness

steps: Partition every span x full t-range and every closure patch into rational rectangles.
Bound q=rprime^2+zprime^2 by exact Bernstein/subdivision bounds; require q_lo>0 and enclose 1/sqrt(q) rationally.
Prove local injectivity on a finite covering by an exact chart bound sup ||A^-1 DF-I||_infinity < 1 for rational nonsingular A.
Prove image-enclosure disjointness for all cell pairs outside a common certified chart.
Emit a complete pair-coverage table; shared seams may meet only at prescribed equal images and must be covered by a joint chart.
proof_routes.result: global injectivity only if the complete finite cover and cell-pair obligations close
